main.description: Bring the named cluster's control plane up: flip the Cluster's desired state to running and materialise its process group and objects, in order. Idempotent and safe to retry - the call flips a declaration and the materialiser does the work. While the cluster is Initializing this method answers 429 with a Retry-After header, which client-go honours automatically; an implementation that retried forever instead would make that promise a lie. Refused once the cluster is Draining, because a process group must not be spawned into a running teardown order. Does NOT provision nodes - nodes are the automatic content-delta trigger's business.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account.

phase.description: The cluster's phase as of this call. Initializing means the 429 is still in force.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record for this account.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.

errors.name: ClusterDraining
errors.description: The cluster is being torn down and its desired state is frozen. Not retryable: a Draining cluster cannot be un-drained, by design - a cancellable teardown gate is a gate an operator clears to make the symptom go away.

errors.name: ClusterInitializing
errors.description: The cluster is still coming up. RETRYABLE: carries Retry-After, and client-go retries on it without further instruction.
